ja423:1.1: Yo indriyānaṃ kāmena vasaṃ Nārada gacchati so pariccajj' ubho loke jīvar eva visussatīti.
ja423:2.1: Sukhassānantaraṃ dukkhaṃ dukkhassānantaraṃ sukhaṃ, sopi patto sukhā dukkhaṃ paṭikaṃkha varaṃ sukhanti.
ja423:3.1: Kicchakāle kicchasaho yo kicchaṃ nātivattati sa kicchantaṃ sukhaṃ dhīro yogaṃ samadhigacchatīti.
ja423:4.1: Na h' eva kāmāna kāmā nānatthā n' atthakāraṇā na katañ ca nikatvāna dhammā cavitum arahasīti.
ja423:5.1: Dukkhaṃ gahapataṃ sādhu, saṃvibhajjañ ca bhojanaṃ, ahāso atthalābhesu, atthavyāpatti avyatho ti.
ja423:6.1: Ettāvatā te paṇḍiccaṃ Asito Devalo bravī, na-y-ito kiñcana pāpiyo yo indriyānaṃ vasaṃ vaje ti.
ja423:7.1: Amittānaṃ va hatthatthaṃ Siva pappoti mām iva, kammaṃ vijjañ ca dakkheyyaṃ vivāhaṃ sīlamaddavaṃ ete ca yase hāpetvā nibbatto sehi kammehi.
ja423:8.1: So 'haṃ sahassajīno va abandhu aparāyano ariyadhammā apakkanto yathā peto tath' ev' ahaṃ.
ja423:9.1: Sukhakāme dukkhāpetvā āpanno 'smi padaṃ imaṃ, so sukhaṃ nādhigacchāmi cito bhānumatā-m-ivā 'ti.
